test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A certain sum of money will be ₹10,800 in 5 years. If simple interest is two-third of the principal, then the rate of interest p.a. is equal to:
solution:
**Given:**

Future Value (A) = ₹10,800

Time (T) = 5 years

Simple interest (SI) = 2/3 of Principal (P)

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = P × R × T / 100

Future Value (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI)

**Calculation:**

Let the Principal be P.

Simple Interest (SI) = 2/3 × P

Future Value (A) = P + SI

⇒ 10,800 = P + (2/3)P

⇒ 10,800 = (3P + 2P) / 3

⇒ 10,800 = 5P / 3

⇒ P = 6,480

Simple Interest (SI) = 2/3 × 6,480 = 4,320

SI = P × R × T / 100

⇒ 4,320 = 6,480 × R × 5 / 100

⇒ 4,320 = 32,400R / 100

⇒ 4,320 = 324R

⇒ R = 4,320 / 324

⇒ R = 13(1)/(3)\%

**The rate of interest p.a. is 13(1)/(3)\%.**
